correctness.rationale: Simultaneous diagonalization and delta<1/L ensure symmetric positive definite B. Sharp one-step SPD residual extremum follows via scalar line search/Kantorovich with explicit weighted endpoint residual. Endpoint error signs and two independent L-modes attain exact two- and higher-dimensional condition ratios. Rational derivative signs, a unique positive quadratic crossing, and a critical noise equality give the three global minimax regimes. Exact-rational verification checks 2100 spectral instances and 2100 residual equality witnesses, 9 boundary equalities; the analytic argument covers all dimensions and parameters.

claim_vs_prior_implication.reasoning: Shah et al. define the augmented inverse application and study its performance, yet neither equation (3.20) nor the reported parameter sweeps yields a uniform optimal omega across an operator-norm uncertainty set. Feinberg et al. discuss circuit compensation but have no deterministic first-step minimax for an exact inverse plus bounded mode-aligned error. originality.rationale: The fully read motivating analog-preconditioning paper uses a reliable identity term, but its perturbation experiments and its proof do not establish this exact mode-aligned robust first-step residual minimax or the duplicate-high-eigenmode dimension transition. Feinberg et al. (2021) study circuitry, and Kalantzis et al. (2021) analyze noisy preconditioned Richardson iterations without optimizing an identity safeguard for one-step GMRES; while the general preconditioner survey and Kantorovich bound supply classical ingredients, not the resulting sharp three-regime safeguard rule. Targeted semantic and web literature searches disclosed no covering comparison. Residual risk: older robust matrix perturbation/condition-number work could have an equivalent closed form; no independent originality audit.
residual_risks: An equivalent exact interval-perturbation safeguard optimization might occur in older robust numerical linear algebra or matrix-inequality work under different terminology.
The flexible GMRES reference was not fully accessible; no NOT_COVERING finding is based on snippets alone.
Published analog hardware models are less constrained than symmetric commuting errors; the present mathematical conclusion cannot be asserted for those models.

value.rationale: A natural designer-selected reliable identity offset has a complete exact one-step worst-case objective and a sharply characterized actionable noise threshold. The 2-versus-3 dimension bifurcation changes optimal damping by order (noise)^2 versus order noise and follows from a structural eigenvalue-multiplicity mechanism; the same bounds are attained with explicit perturbations. This is mathematically motivated by the analog-inverse preconditioning architecture and not just a renamed textbook inequality. Scope is intentionally the commuting deterministic baseline, not a claim about actual analog-hardware probabilities or multi-step performance.
